definitions.explanation: A sum of money imposed as punishment for breaking a law, rule, or regulation. Used in both legal and informal contexts.

examples.japanese: {罰金|ばっきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
⟦{駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}→駐車違反：21077_chuushaihan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{罰金|ばっきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}られた→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I was fined for a parking violation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}→飲酒運転：18486_inshuunten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高額|こうがく}→高額：14704_kougaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{罰金|ばっきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{科|か}せられる⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Drunk driving can result in a heavy fine.

notes: Common collocations: {罰金|ばっきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay a fine), {罰金|ばっきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{科|か}す / {罰金|ばっきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{科|か}せられる (to impose a fine / to have a fine imposed), {罰金|ばっきん}{刑|けい} (fine as a criminal penalty). In Japanese law, {罰金|ばっきん} is a formal criminal penalty, distinct from {反則金|はんそくきん} (infraction penalty — the administrative fine for minor traffic violations). Informally, {罰金|ばっきん} is used casually for any monetary penalty, even playful ones among friends. Related: {科料|かりょう} (minor fine — a lighter criminal penalty), ⟦{違約金|いやくきん}→違約金：09819_iyakukin⟧ (penalty for breach of contract).
